finalText:
Done. I moved 11 files off `db.query` and onto `db.execute({ sql, params })`: `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `returnService.js`, `couponService.js`, `session.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`, and `refund.js`.

One file still calls `db.query`: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. I left it alone on purpose. It's a vendored copy of a third-party library, and its own header says local edits get wiped on every upgrade.
